about: Global write-time junk list for dealer_inventory_options. Applied to EVERY car, whether or not a model policy covers it. Edit patterns here (deals-api picks the file up at its next restart; OPTION_JUNK_RULES_PATH can point at another file, OPTION_JUNK_RULES=off turns the list off). Each pattern is a JavaScript regex source matched case-insensitively against the option name. A line is never dropped by this list when it is a vouched factory option: a model-policy entry (name or order code) or a make-allowlist key.

exemptions.name: roadside-assistance-kit
exemptions.note: A physical emergency kit in the car, not the roadside-assistance plan.

exemptions.name: maintenance-indicators
exemptions.note: 'Shift-position and scheduled maintenance indicators' is an instrument-cluster feature, not a maintenance plan.

rewrites.name: siriusxm-trial
rewrites.note: SiriusXM is a real factory option; many feeds list it only as a trial-subscription line. Becomes the plain option, so the car keeps SiriusXM and the trial wording is gone. Paid extras (Extended Service, Traffic and Travel Link, protection plans) are not rewritten: they stay junk-list subscription lines.

zeroPrice.about: OFF until measured on live data (2026-10-16 dry run pending). When on, an explicit price of 0 is a $0 / standard / included line. A missing price (null) is unknown and is kept. Lines whose code is listed in exemptCodes carry price 0 as 'unknown, not free' (descriptionFeatures.js) and are kept.
